userStories.title: View Current Usage Allowances
userStories.description: As a Vodafone UK mobile customer, I want to view my current usage allowances (data, minutes, texts) with visual progress indicators, So that I can monitor my consumption and avoid exceeding my plan limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Given I am a logged-in customer, When I navigate to the Usage screen, Then the system retrieves my usage data from the /usage API endpoint (version 2) using GET method
Given usage data is available, When the Usage screen loads, Then I see allowance cards displaying icon, header, quantity, unit, percentage remaining, and progress bar for each allowance type
Given an allowance has unlimited usage, When the allowance is displayed, Then the progress bar shows 100% filled regardless of actual consumption
Given an allowance has limited usage, When the allowance is displayed, Then the progress bar shows the percentageRemaining value as a visual indicator
Given the unit position is configured as 'left', When displaying quantity, Then the format is '{remainingUnit}{quantity}'
Given the unit position is configured as 'right', When displaying quantity, Then the format is '{quantity} {remainingUnit}'
Given allowance data includes riderText with HTML content, When the allowance is displayed, Then the rider text renders as formatted HTML with clickable links

userStories.title: View Grouped Allowances
userStories.description: As a customer with grouped services (e.g., family plans), I want to view grouped allowance data, So that I can understand shared resource consumption across multiple lines.
acceptanceCriteria: Given I have a grouped allowance plan, When the Usage screen loads, Then the system displays grouped allowance sections with header, title, subtitle, and progress indicators
Given a grouped allowance is unlimited, When displayed, Then the progress bar shows 100% filled
Given a grouped allowance has percentage remaining, When displayed, Then the progress bar reflects the actual percentage consumed
Given grouped allowances exist, When rendered, Then each item shows icon, header label, value label, and status bar with appropriate accessibility identifiers

userStories.title: Navigate Through Allowance Details via Deep Links
userStories.description: As a customer viewing usage details, I want to click on embedded links within allowance descriptions, So that I can access related services or detailed information.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an allowance card contains HTML with embedded URLs in riderText or headerText, When I tap on a link, Then the system executes the journey specified by the URL
Given a link is tapped within a usage section, When the navigation occurs, Then the system tracks the button tapping action with link type, screen name 'Usage', and page section 'SubsOverlay'
Given navigation is triggered via URL, When the journey executes, Then the system prevents default browser behavior and handles routing internally

userStories.title: View Usage Information Banner
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to see contextual information banners on usage cards, So that I can be informed of important status messages or alerts related to my usage.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a usage card includes an infoBanner object, When the card is displayed, Then I see the banner with text, background color, font color, leading icon, and trailing icon
Given the info banner is present, When rendered, Then it displays above the usage sections within the card
Given no info banner is configured, When the card is displayed, Then the banner section is hidden

userStories.title: Interact with Usage Card Action Buttons
userStories.description: As a customer viewing my usage, I want to see and interact with action buttons on usage cards (e.g., 'Top Up', 'Manage Extras'), So that I can quickly perform relevant tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a usage card contains a buttons array, When the card is displayed, Then action buttons render below the usage sections
Given action buttons are present, When I tap a button, Then the system executes the associated journey with configured parameters
Given an action button is tapped, When the action executes, Then the system tracks the button tap event with button type, screen name 'Usage', page section 'SubsOverlay', and page subsection 'Usage'
Given buttons are rendered, When displayed, Then each button has accessibility identifier 'btnUsageCTA'

userStories.title: Browse Usage Extras in Carousel View
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to browse additional usage-related services or products in a horizontal carousel, So that I can discover and access extra features relevant to my account.
acceptanceCriteria: Given usage response includes extras with viewType 'carousel', When the Usage screen loads, Then a horizontal scrollable carousel displays below usage cards
Given carousel items are displayed, When rendered, Then each item shows icon, header image, title, body text, and navigation arrow
Given a carousel item has a remote image location, When displayed, Then the system fetches the image from the URL with Kingfisher library and uses fallback icon if loading fails
Given I tap on a carousel item, When the tap occurs, Then the system executes the journey specified by journeyKey with serviceGroupID parameters
Given a carousel item is tapped, When navigation occurs, Then the system saves serviceGroupID to memory cache for the active MSISDN
Given a carousel item is tapped, When the action executes, Then the system tracks the event with sanitized event label (HTML tags removed), link type, and usage screen tracking constants
Given the carousel has multiple items, When displayed, Then the width adjusts to show partial next item (collection width minus 32 points)
Given carousel items all have empty body text, When rendered, Then the collection height constraint is set to 200 points, otherwise 240 points
Given I scroll the carousel, When I finish dragging, Then the system snaps to the nearest item with spring animation

userStories.title: Browse Usage Extras in Tiles List View
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to view additional usage-related services in a vertical tiles list, So that I can easily scan and select services without horizontal scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Given usage response includes extras with viewType 'tilesList', When the Usage screen loads, Then a vertical list of tiles displays below usage cards
Given tiles list items are displayed, When rendered, Then each tile shows icon, title, optional body text, and navigation arrow within a card view with shadow
Given I tap on a tile item, When the tap occurs, Then the system executes the journey specified by journeyKey with serviceGroupID parameters
Given a tile is tapped, When navigation occurs, Then the system saves serviceGroupID to memory cache for the active MSISDN
Given a tile is tapped, When the action executes, Then the system tracks the button tapping action with lowercased title, button type, and usage tracking constants
Given a tile item has no body text, When rendered, Then the tile height is 60 points, otherwise 100 points
Given tiles are rendered, When displayed, Then each tile has drop shadow with opacity 0.1, offset (0,0), radius 6, and corner radius 6

userStories.title: View Footer Actions on Usage Screen
userStories.description: As a customer viewing usage, I want to see footer-level action buttons, So that I can perform account-wide actions related to usage management.
acceptanceCriteria: Given usage response includes a buttons array at root level, When the Usage screen loads, Then footer action buttons render at the bottom of the main stack
Given footer actions are present, When I tap a button, Then the system executes the associated journey
Given a footer action is tapped, When the action executes, Then the system tracks the button tapping action with button type, screen name, page section 'SubsOverlay', and page subsection 'Usage'
Given footer buttons are rendered, When displayed, Then each button has accessibility identifier 'btnUsageCTA'

userStories.title: Retry Failed Usage Data Retrieval
userStories.description: As a customer experiencing a loading error, I want to retry fetching my usage data, So that I can view my information without restarting the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the usage API call fails, When an error screen is displayed, Then I see a retry action option
Given I tap the retry action, When the action executes, Then the system re-invokes the /usage API endpoint
Given the retry is successful, When usage data loads, Then the error screen is replaced with usage content
Given the retry fails again, When the error occurs, Then the error screen remains visible with retry option

userStories.title: Handle Usage Data Caching
userStories.description: As a customer, I want my usage data to be cached locally, So that I can view my usage quickly without waiting for network requests on subsequent visits.
acceptanceCriteria: Given I have previously loaded usage data, When I navigate to the Usage screen, Then the system checks memory cache for valid cached data before making API call
Given cached data exists and is valid, When the Usage screen loads, Then the system displays cached data immediately
Given the cache policy determines API call is needed, When the Usage screen loads, Then the system fetches fresh data from /usage endpoint
Given fresh data is retrieved, When the response arrives, Then the system updates the memory cache with new data for the active MSISDN
Given data status is 'uptodate' and differs from previous state, When received, Then the system forwards the new model to the UI

userStories.title: Track Usage Screen Interactions for Analytics
userStories.description: As a product owner, I want to track user interactions on the Usage screen, So that I can analyze user behavior and optimize the experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the Usage screen loads successfully, When usage data is displayed, Then the system tracks page view event with screen name 'Usage', page section 'SubsOverlay', page subsection 'Usage', and visitor fast pass status if available
Given a user taps an extra carousel item, When the tap occurs, Then the system tracks the event with sanitized event label (HTML removed), link type, and usage event category
Given a user taps a tiles list item, When the tap occurs, Then the system tracks the event with lowercased title, button type, and usage event category
Given a user taps a link within a usage section, When the tap occurs, Then the system tracks the event with text content, link type, and screen name 'Usage'
Given tracking events fire, When sent to analytics, Then they include page type, page currency value, and event category from tracking constants

userStories.title: Handle Invalid Authentication During Usage Retrieval
userStories.description: As a system, I want to detect invalid or expired authentication tokens during usage data retrieval, So that the user can be prompted to re-authenticate.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the /usage API call returns an invalid full access token error code, When the error is received, Then the system emits the error to the base error subject
Given an invalid token error is detected, When handled by the base view controller, Then the system triggers re-authentication flow
Given other API errors occur (non-authentication), When the error is received, Then the system displays the error screen with retry option

userStories.title: Support Accessibility Features in Usage Display
userStories.description: As a customer using assistive technologies, I want usage components to have proper accessibility labels and identifiers, So that I can navigate and understand my usage information.
acceptanceCriteria: Given allowance views are displayed, When rendered, Then icon has accessibility identifier 'imgUsageProductItemIcon', header has 'txtUsageProductItemLabel', and progress bar has 'imgUsageProductItemStatusBar'

Given grouped allowance views are displayed, When rendered, Then icon has accessibility identifier 'imgGroupDataSubItemIcon', header has 'txtGropDataSubItemlabel', value has 'txtGropDataSubItemValue', and bar has 'imgGroupDataSubItemBar'

Given quantity and suffix labels are displayed, When rendered, Then quantity label has isAccessibilityElement set to false, and suffix label has combined accessibility label with quantity and suffix text
Given extra carousel title is displayed, When rendered, Then title label has accessibility identifier 'mainTitleLabel' and collection view has identifier 'container'
Given carousel cells are displayed, When rendered, Then icon, header, arrow, title, and description each have specific accessibility identifiers
Given tiles list cells are displayed, When rendered, Then icon, arrow, title, and description each have specific accessibility identifiers
